why_this_family: Their $600,000 home purchase is in 2030; rising prices may change the budget, but there is time.
subject: Home prices and your 2030 plans
draft: Timothy and Melanie, home prices in major US markets are up 6% over the past year. Your plan has a $600,000 home purchase in 2030, so there's time, and one year of prices doesn't set the price you'll pay then. Your current home, valued at $350,000, is part of the picture too. Nothing to do today. When we next review, let's check whether $600,000 is still the right figure for the home you want and how it fits next to college saving for Liam and Josh.
voice_script: Hi Timothy and Melanie, it's Mohamed. Home prices have gone up, and you're planning a home purchase in 2030. There's time and nothing to do today, but at our next review let's check that the budget still fits the home you want.
